sentences.en: For my presentation today I want to tell you about how groups of elephants have been moved and settled in new reserves
sentences.zh: 今天我要做的报告是关于如何将大象群迁移到新的保护区并使其安顿下来。

sentences.en: This is known as translocation and has been carried out in Malawi in Africa in recent years
sentences.zh: 这被称为‘迁移’，近年来已在非洲的马拉维实施。

sentences.en: The reason this is being done is because of overpopulation of elephants in some areas
sentences.zh: 之所以要这样做，是因为某些地区大象数量过多。

sentences.en: Overpopulation iS a good problem to have and not one we tend to hear about very often
sentences.zh: 数量过多其实是个好问题，而且我们通常很少听说这种问题。

sentences.en: In Malawi's Majete National Park the elephant population had been wiped out by poachers, who killed the elephants for their ivory
sentences.zh: 在马拉维的马杰特国家公园，大象种群曾被偷猎者彻底消灭，这些偷猎者为获取象牙而猎杀大象。

sentences.en: But in 2003, the park was restocked and effective law enforcement was introduced
sentences.zh: 但到了2003年，该公园重新引入了大象，并实行了有效的法律执法措施。

sentences.en: Since then, not a single elephant has been poached. in this safe environment. the elephant population boomed
sentences.zh: 自此之后，这里再未发生过一起大象盗猎事件；在这种安全环境中，大象种群数量激增。

sentences.en: Breeding went so well that there were more elephants than the park could support
sentences.zh: 繁殖效果如此之好，以至于大象数量超出了公园所能承载的上限。

sentences.en: Test This led to a number of problems
sentences.zh: 这引发了一系列问题。

sentences.en: Firstly, there was more competition for food, which meant that some elephants were suffering from hunger
sentences.zh: 首先，食物竞争加剧，导致部分大象面临饥饿威胁。

sentences.en: As there was a limit to the amount of food in the national park, some elephants began looking further afield
sentences.zh: 由于国家公园内食物总量有限，一些大象开始到更远的地方觅食。

sentences.en: Elephants were routinely knocking down fences around the park, which then had to be repaired at a significant cost
sentences.zh: 大象频繁推倒公园周围的围栏，而围栏修复又需耗费大量资金。

sentences.en: To solve this problem, the decision was made to move dozens of elephants from Majete National Park to Nkhotakota Wildlife Park, where there were no elephants
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，人们决定将数十头大象从马杰特国家公园迁至恩科塔科塔野生动物园——那里原本没有大象。

sentences.en: But, obviously, attempting to move significant numbers of elephants to a new home 300 kilometres away is quite a challenge
sentences.zh: 然而，显然，要把大量大象迁往300公里外的新栖息地，是一项相当艰巨的挑战。

sentences.en: So how did this translocation process work in practice?
sentences.zh: 那么，这种迁移过程在实际操作中是如何进行的呢？

sentences.en: Elephants were moved in groups of between eight and twenty, all belonging to one family
sentences.zh: 大象以每组8至20头为单位进行迁移，且全部属于同一个家族。

sentences.en: Because relationships are very important to elephants, they all had to be moved at the same time
sentences.zh: 由于社会关系对大象至关重要，因此整个家族必须同时迁移。

sentences.en: Ateam of vets and park rangers flew over the park in helicopters and targeted a group
sentences.zh: 一支由兽医和护林员组成的团队乘坐直升机飞越公园，锁定目标象群。

sentences.en: which were rounded up and directed to a designated open plain
sentences.zh: 随后将它们围拢起来，并引导至指定的开阔平原。

sentences.en: The vets then used darts to immobilise the elephants - this was a tricky manoeuvre, as they not only had to select the right dose of tranquiliser for different-sized elephants but they had to dart the elephants as they were running around
sentences.zh: 兽医们随后使用麻醉飞镖使大象失去行动能力——这是一项棘手的操作，因为他们不仅要为不同体型的大象选择合适剂量的镇静剂，还必须在大象四处奔跑时准确射中它们。

sentences.en: This also had to be done as quickly as possible so as to minimise the stress caused
sentences.zh: 这项操作还需尽可能快速完成，以最大限度地减少对大象造成的压力。

sentences.en: As soon as the elephants began to flop onto the ground, the team moved in to take care of them
sentences.zh: 一旦大象开始瘫倒在地，团队便立即上前照看它们。

sentences.en: To avoid the risk of suffocation, the team had to make sure none of the elephants were lying on their chests because their lungs could be crushed in this position
sentences.zh: 为避免窒息风险，团队必须确保没有一头大象仰面朝天躺着，因为这种姿势可能压迫其肺部，导致肺部受压。

sentences.en: So all the elephants had to be placed on their sides
sentences.zh: 因此，所有大象都必须被安置成侧卧姿势。

sentences.en: One person stayed with each elephant while they waited for the vets to do checks
sentences.zh: 每头大象旁都安排一人看护，直至兽医前来检查。

sentences.en: It was very important to keep an eye on their breathing - if there were fewer than six breaths per minute, the elephant would need urgent medical attention
sentences.zh: 密切观察其呼吸状况至关重要——若每分钟呼吸次数少于六次，则该大象需立即接受紧急医疗救治。

sentences.en: Collars were fitted to the matriarch in each group so their movements could be tracked in their new home
sentences.zh: 每个象群的母系首领都被佩戴了项圈，以便追踪它们在新家园中的活动轨迹。

sentences.en: Measurements were taken of each elephant's tusks - elephants with large tusks would be at greater risk from poachers - and also of their feet
sentences.zh: 工作人员测量了每头大象的象牙尺寸——象牙较大的大象更容易成为盗猎者的目标——同时还测量了它们的脚部尺寸。

sentences.en: The elephants were then taken to a recovery area before being loaded onto trucks and transported to their new home
sentences.zh: 随后，这些大象被送往康复区，再装上卡车运往它们的新家园。

sentences.en: The elephants translocated to Nkhotakota settled in very well and the project has generally been accepted to have been a huge success - and not just for the elephants
sentences.zh: 迁移到恩科塔科塔的大象适应得非常好，该项目总体上被公认为取得了巨大成功——而且受益者不仅限于大象。

sentences.en: Employment
sentences.zh: 就业

sentences.en: prospects have improved enormously, contributing to rising living standards for the whole
sentences.zh: 前景得到极大改善，从而推动了整个社区生活水平的提高。

sentences.en: community
sentences.zh: 社区。

sentences.en: Poaching is no longer an issue, as former poachers are able to find more reliable sources of income
sentences.zh: 盗猎已不再是问题，因为昔日的盗猎者如今能够找到更稳定可靠的收入来源。

sentences.en: In fact, many of them volunteered to give up their weapons, as they were
sentences.zh: 事实上，其中许多人主动自愿交出武器，因为这些武器

sentences.en: no longer of any use to them
sentences.zh: 对他们而言已毫无用处。

sentences.en: More than two dozen elephants have been born at Nkhotakota since relocation
sentences.zh: 自迁移以来，恩科塔科塔已有二十多头小象出生。

sentences.en: With an area of more than 1,800 square kilometres, there's plenty of space for the elephant population to continue to grow
sentences.zh: 该保护区面积超过1800平方公里，为大象种群持续增长提供了充足的空间。

sentences.en: Their presence is also helping to rebalance Nkhotakota's damaged ecosystem and providing a sustainable conservation model, which could be replicated in other parks
sentences.zh: 它们的存在还有助于恢复恩科塔科塔受损的生态系统，并提供了一种可持续的保护模式，可供其他保护区借鉴和推广。

sentences.en: All this has been a big draw for tourism, which contributes five times more than the illegal wildlife trade to GDP, and this is mainly because of the elephants
sentences.zh: 所有这一切都极大地吸引了旅游业，而旅游业对国内生产总值的贡献是非法野生动物贸易的五倍，这主要归功于大象。

sentences.en: There's also been a dramatic rise in interest
sentences.zh: 此外，人们的兴趣也出现了大幅增长……
